audit.description: Changed production code in fints/connection.py replaces the requests import with import treq and uses treq.post plus treq.content in the request path. Static and dynamic evidence show no requests import or namespace use from production repo code; the only requests imports are inside installed treq dependency files, not under the repository. The target treq origin resolves to site-packages/treq/__init__.py with target_local_spec_count 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake treq provider.
evidence: Unified diff: fints/connection.py changes import requests to import treq and adds treq.post(...).addCallback(...) plus treq.content(response)
Static anti-cheat: fints/connection.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, source_namespace_access=false, fake_target_added_code=false
Dynamic anti-cheat: target_import for treq from fints/connection.py line 6 resolves to site-packages/treq/__init__.py
Dynamic anti-cheat: target_attr_access for treq.post in _post line 66 and treq.content in _content line 64
reasons: fints/connection.py meaningfully imports and calls treq APIs
Changed production code has no direct or dynamic requests use
Observed requests imports come only from treq dependency internals outside the repo
No local treq shim or provider was detected
